description: Initialize CDK TypeScript project structure with proper configuration files, directory layout, and updated Lambda function code. This establishes the foundation for all subsequent CDK stack conversions.
steps: Create package.json with aws-cdk-lib, constructs, typescript, @types/node, jest, ts-jest dependencies
Create tsconfig.json with strict TypeScript configuration for CDK projects (target ES2020, moduleResolution node, strict mode)
Create cdk.json with app entry point (bin/app.ts) and CDK context settings
Create bin/app.ts entry point that instantiates all stacks with proper environment configuration
Create lambda/ directory structure: lambda/calculator/, lambda/create-vpc-flowlogs/, lambda/load-az-cidr/, lambda/update-ddb-table/
Copy and update Calculator.py to lambda/calculator/index.py - update to Python 3.11+ syntax, add type hints, improve error handling
Copy and update CreateVpcFlowlogs.py to lambda/create-vpc-flowlogs/index.py - update to Python 3.11+ syntax, add type hints
Copy and update LoadAZCidr.py to lambda/load-az-cidr/index.py - update to Python 3.11+ syntax, add type hints
Copy and update UpdateDDBTable.py to lambda/update-ddb-table/index.py - update to Python 3.11+ syntax, add type hints
Create lib/ directory for CDK constructs
acceptance_criteria: package.json exists with all required CDK and TypeScript dependencies
cdk.json properly configured for TypeScript CDK app
All 4 Lambda functions exist in lambda/ directory with Python 3.11+ compatible code
Lambda code includes type hints and uses modern Python constructs
Directory structure matches CDK best practices
verification: Run 'tsc --noEmit' to validate TypeScript configuration and any .ts files
Check Python syntax with 'python3 -m py_compile lambda/*/index.py'
findings: Python validation requires Python 3.11+ (use pyenv's 3.11.14 for match statements). TypeScript validation passes with tsc --noEmit using type stubs since npm install is unavailable in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY mode. The actual aws-cdk-lib types will be available when npm install is run in a network-enabled environment.
